features: Health Hub: Seamlessly integrated with the seniorshield app to track vitals, store medical records, enable doctor consults, send health reminders, and alert caregivers in real time
Engagement Hub: Keeps seniors active with brain games, volunteering, job listings, and local events
Retail Hub: Curated marketplace for health supplements, assistive devices, senior travel, and more
SOS button and Automatic fall detection instantly alerts caregivers during emergencies
Monitors heart rate, BP, SpO2, temperature, sleep, and steps

Watch can be used without the app access as well. You can continue to track all vitals on the watch in real time.

IP67 water-resistant design for daily wear, rain, or showers
Senior-friendly 1.83" touch screen, lightweight, easy controls
